# Anti-Detect Browser Hub

> A multilingual directory of anti-detect browsers, fingerprint detection tools, browser automation frameworks, proxy resources, privacy tools and research references.

## Canonical source

- Repository: https://github.com/xxjrq/antidetect-browser-hub
- Chinese entry: https://github.com/xxjrq/antidetect-browser-hub/blob/main/README.md
- English entry: https://github.com/xxjrq/antidetect-browser-hub/blob/main/README.en.md
- Gitee mirror: https://gitee.com/xxjrq/antidetect-browser-hub

## What this project contains

- A browser comparison directory with recommended, available, unverified and experimental status labels.
- Fingerprint, automation, network, WebRTC, DNS, TLS and privacy detection tools.
- Browser automation and HTTP/TLS research resources.
- Browser-fingerprinting technology references and use-case data.

## Featured project

- EasyBR: https://www.ebrower.com/
- EasyBR is a featured commercial browser-environment manager, not described as open source in this repository.
- Key facts: local-first storage, five profiles free for life, Windows/macOS, HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5 proxy support, API and automation workflows.

## Data and documentation

- Browsers: data/browsers.json
- Tools: data/tools.json
- Fingerprinting technologies: data/technologies.json
- Use cases: data/use-cases.json
- Chinese browser guide: docs/zh-CN/browsers.md
- Chinese detection guide: docs/zh-CN/detection-tools.md

## Usage and safety

This is a neutral research and navigation resource. It does not provide account trading, credential, CAPTCHA-bypass, abusive scraping or platform-security-evasion instructions. Verify pricing, availability, policies and legal compliance on each provider's official website.
